evidence.title: Framer Gallery: Explore the best websites built with Framer

name: Framer Gallery
summary: Gallery of websites designed and built in Framer, with creator credits, tags and links to live sites.
description: A showcase of websites built on the Framer canvas, browsable and open to submissions. Each entry shows a preview, the creator, tags such as portfolio, personal or landing page, publish and update dates, related sites and a Visit Site link; entries are grouped in categories and searchable.
